tool_schemas.name: weather
tool_schemas.description: Fetches current weather conditions for the specified location (by name and/or latitude/longitude) using the selected provider and returns the resolved weather payload, optionally including the provider raw_payload when include_raw_payload is true; repeated calls with the same idempotency_key are de-duplicated and return the original result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when api_key is missing/doesn’t match the required pattern, when latitude/longitude are out of range, when provider/units/request_source are not one of the allowed values, or when unknown parameters are provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the api_key is not recognized, RATE_LIMITED when the client exceeds request rate limits, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client exceeds its usage quota for weather calls, and PROVIDER_ERROR when the upstream provider cannot fulfill the request (including invalid/unsupported location inputs).

api_key.description: API key id used to identify the client and enforce quotas (api_keys.id).

location_name.description: Human-readable location name (e.g., city) to resolve weather for.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees for the weather lookup.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees for the weather lookup.

provider.description: Preferred weather data provider to use when fetching conditions.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name to use for interpreting timestamps (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles').

request_source.description: Source channel for the request for logging/analytics.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to de-duplicate repeated identical requests.

units.description: Unit system preference for returned values.

include_raw_payload.description: Whether to include the provider raw_payload in the response.

tool_schemas.name: me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity for the provided api_key, including its current status, effective rate-limit/quota settings, and the current minute/day usage counters. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR when the api_key is missing, invalid, disabled, or revoked.

api_key.description: API key id used to identify the client and enforce quotas (api_keys.id).

tool_schemas.name: api_keys.list
tool_schemas.description: Lists API keys visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status/owner and paginated. Returns key metadata but never returns the raw secret key material. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR when the caller api_key is invalid/disabled/revoked.

api_key.description: API key id used to authorize this operation (api_keys.id).

status.description: Filter results by api key status.

limit.description: Maximum number of API keys to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: api_keys.create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key record and returns the new key once at creation time along with its metadata. Stores only key_hash and key_prefix; the raw key cannot be retrieved later. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields and with AUTH_ERROR when the caller api_key is invalid/disabled/revoked.

api_key.description: API key id used to authorize this operation (api_keys.id).

requests_per_minute_limit.description: Per-minute request limit enforced for this key.

requests_per_day_limit.description: Per-day request limit enforced for this key.

tool_schemas.name: api_keys.update
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable API key fields (label, limits) and/or transitions its status via the status field (active/disabled/revoked). Refuses with CONFLICT_ERROR for invalid lifecycle transitions and with AUTH_ERROR when the caller api_key is invalid/disabled/revoked.

api_key.description: API key id used to authorize this operation (api_keys.id).

id.description: The API key id to update (api_keys.id).

status.description: New status for the key. Allowed transitions: active->(disabled|revoked), disabled->(active|revoked); revoked cannot change.

tool_schemas.name: weather_requests.list
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded weather tool invocations, optionally filtered by api_key_id, status, time range, and idempotency_key. Returns request audit metadata and status fields; does not include the full weather payload unless joined via weather_responses. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR when the caller api_key is invalid/disabled/revoked.

api_key.description: API key id used to authorize this operation (api_keys.id).

api_key_id.description: Filter to requests made under a specific API key id.

created_after.description: Only include requests created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Only include requests created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: provider_configs.update
tool_schemas.description: Updates provider configuration fields and/or transitions provider config status (active/disabled). Refuses with CONFLICT_ERROR for invalid transitions and with VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported provider/auth_type combinations.

api_key.description: API key id used to authorize this operation (api_keys.id).

status.description: New provider config status. Allowed transitions: active<->disabled.

base_url.description: Base URL for the provider API.

auth_type.description: Authentication mode used for upstream calls.

api_key_ref.description: Reference to the upstream provider credential (not the client api_key). Required when auth_type='api_key'.

priority.description: Lower numbers are preferred during provider selection.

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts for upstream calls.

metadata.name: Weather MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores invocations of a single Weather MCP tool and the resulting weather payloads returned to clients. It also tracks client identities (API keys) and enforces basic usage quotas and rate limits for the weather endpoint. Repository: https://github.com/CodeByWaqas/weather-mcp-server Hom
